seo.metaTitle: Sunshine Coast Oral, Facial & Implant Specialists Services
seo.metaDescription: Sunshine Coast Oral, Facial & Implant Specialists provide an extensive range of specialised medical and dental treatments.
seo.ogTitle: Services | Sunshine Coast Oral, Facial & Implant Specialists

f3.value: The full scope of oral and maxillofacial surgery

f4.value: From straightforward wisdom teeth to zygomatic implants and jaw reconstruction, every procedure is planned and performed by a specialist surgeon, in the setting that suits your case.

f3.value: Impacted and complex wisdom teeth removed in a single appointment, asleep or sedated.

f7.value: Specialist placement of single and multiple implants, including immediate implants after extraction.

f11.value: A fixed full arch on four or more implants, usually with teeth on the same day.

f15.value: Remote anchorage implants for patients told they have too little bone for conventional implants.

f19.value: Socket preservation, sinus lifts and block grafts to rebuild bone before implants.

f23.value: Orthognathic surgery in partnership with your orthodontist to correct bite and facial balance.

f27.value: Repair of jaw, cheekbone, orbital and nasal fractures, and soft tissue injuries.
